description:
Independently re-verify a validation certificate. Integrity mode checks
    the hash chain; full mode (certificate + original data) recomputes
    every attested rule from scratch - trust nothing, recheck everything.

certificate.description: The certificate object from a prior validation response
certificate.title: Certificate

data.description: Original payload for full re-verification; omit for integrity-only mode
data.title: Data

derivation_rules.description: Rule list for independent attestation recomputation (optional)
derivation_rules.title: Derivation Rules

formal_constraints.description: Optional constraints to match against the committed bundle
formal_constraints.title: Formal Constraints

name: verify_certificate
